title: 044 - Castlevania
method: claude-code: written from the transcript, links verified by script

items.name: Castlevania
items.description: The episode's game: Konami's 1986 gothic action-platformer starring Simon Belmont against Dracula.

items.name: Konami
items.description: Publisher and developer of Castlevania, Gradius and Ghosts 'n Goblins' fellow-era hits.

links.label: Wikipedia: Konami
links.note: Japanese entertainment and video game company

items.name: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
items.description: The later PlayStation Castlevania whose save file a Metal Gear Solid boss comments on.

links.label: Wikipedia: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night

items.name: Metal Gear Solid
items.description: The PlayStation game where Psycho Mantis reads your memory card and reacts to Castlevania saves.

items.name: Gradius
items.description: Konami's earlier shooter covered on the show, also known for its power-up system and Moai heads.

items.name: Trojan
items.description: An earlier arcade-first side-scroller covered on the show, compared with Castlevania.

items.name: Ghosts 'n Goblins
items.description: Capcom's earlier, much harder arcade-first platformer, compared with Castlevania.

items.name: Famicom Disk System
items.description: Nintendo's Japanese disk add-on, where Castlevania first appeared with saving.

items.name: Super Mario Bros.
items.description: Used as the comparison for pacing, power-ups and story throughout the episode.

items.name: Simon Belmont
items.description: The whip-wielding hero of Castlevania, called Simon Belmondo in Japan and the movie credits.

items.name: Dracula
items.description: The vampire lord resurrected every hundred years, and the game's final boss.

items.name: Universal Classic Monsters
items.description: The 1930s Universal horror films whose monsters populate the castle.

items.name: Mega Man
items.description: Compared for its enemy-specific weapons, early in the sub-weapon discussion.

items.name: Egoraptor
